title: Config: structured per-peer table with cert pin and auth
description:
The [peers] section is a flat list of IP:port strings with no per-peer metadata:

  addresses = ["192.0.2.10:119", "192.0.2.20:119"]

This cannot express cert fingerprints, expected peer identity, or per-peer auth tokens needed for TLS peering (see companion TLS issue). Replace with an array of tables:

  [[peers.peer]]
  addr = "192.0.2.10:119"
  tls = true
  cert_sha256 = "aa:bb:cc:..."   # pinned DER cert fingerprint
  # auth_token = "..."           # optional shared secret

Maintain backward-compat parse path or provide a migration note. Config validation should reject tls=true entries with no cert_sha256.
